about: Derived data cache policy of the Unreal Verse (docs/verse/unreal/architecture.md 8.1). Local only, never a shared cloud cache. package.py passes -ddc=<graph> and sets <local_path_env>; package.py hygiene keeps the cache under cap_gb, prunes Intermediate folders of worktrees untouched for intermediate_max_age_days and alerts below alert_free_gb free.
